KSP
, namespace ara::crypto::keys) is responsible for se-

Key Material
(public,
private, secret keys, or seeds) and other security critical cryptographic objects (digital
signatures, hash,
MAC
HMAC tags). These cryptographic objects are represented as
a
Key Slots
.

Cryp-
toKeySlot
